# Venue memo

Primary target: **Journal of Mathematical Physics**.

Rationale: the manuscript is a theorem-led mathematical-physics paper joining
finite lattice gauge geometry, convex analysis, and reproducible exact
certification. Its value lies in an explicit method and proof artifact rather
than a completed constructive field theory.

Fallback 1: **Journal of Statistical Physics**, especially if the framing
emphasizes log-concave conditional measures and exact finite-system
marginalization.

Fallback 2: **Letters in Mathematical Physics**, if the exposition is
compressed and the certificate is treated as a supplement.

Do not target a venue expecting a continuum Yang--Mills construction or
phenomenological lattice numerics. The title and abstract must retain
“one local marginalization” and the finite-block scope.
